seo.homeTitle: WordSprint | Fast daily word games in four languages
seo.homeDescription: Play Daily Ladder, Word Scramble, and Typo Hunt with instant local gameplay in English, Turkish, Dutch, and Indonesian.
seo.dailyDescription: Climb from the start word to the target by changing one letter at a time.
seo.scrambleDescription: Unscramble as many words as you can before the sixty-second timer runs out.
seo.typoDescription: Spot the misspelled word across ten quick rounds.

home.title: Quick word games built for short, satisfying rounds.
home.subtitle: Switch languages, jump into a short round, and play instantly on desktop or phone.
home.dailyBody: Move from one word to another by changing one letter at a time.
home.scrambleBody: Race the clock for one minute and solve as many mixed-up words as you can.
home.typoBody: Find the one misspelled option in each quick set.

daily.title: Daily Ladder
daily.body: Bridge the start and target words by changing one letter on each move.
daily.invalid: That rung has already been used.
daily.tooShort: Use a word with the same length as the ladder.
daily.win: Clean solve. Today's ladder is complete.
daily.completed: Come back tomorrow for a fresh ladder.
daily.rule: Only one letter can change each turn.
daily.hintBody: Meaning clue for the next rung
daily.invalidBounce: That word is outside today's ladder.
daily.retryHint: Two off-ladder tries unlocked a clue.

scramble.title: Word Scramble
scramble.body: Unscramble each word before the timer hits zero.

typo.title: Typo Hunt
typo.body: Find the single misspelled word in each round.
